name: asana
description: Runs 118 bounded source-backed direct-read commands and 96 approval-gated one-record direct-write commands. The same 12 declared streams and 96 write actions remain available to saved-connection ETL and warehouse-table reverse ETL. The pinned OpenAPI ledger accounts for every official operation as an executable covered_by route, an exact named foundation gap, or the one not-applicable generic batch wrapper.

risk.read: external Asana API reads use fixed declared streams or bounded source-bound operations; no raw provider query/path passthrough
risk.write: external mutations require named write actions, schemas, previews, explicit approval, and typed destructive confirmation when destructive/admin; interactive commands are one-record direct writes while warehouse-table reverse ETL remains system-level
risk.approval: all write execution follows plan -> preview -> explicit approval -> execute; destructive actions also require confirm: destructive
